'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Kivu conflict]]
**[[M23 offensive (2022–present)|M23 offensive]]
***The [[mining]] town of Rubaya, [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]], is seized by the [[March 23 Movement]]. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-rebels-mining-smartphones-efeccc189dfa64a2a010fd3240fc3880 (AP)]
**Twelve people are killed and more than 20 others are injured during explosions caused by [[bomb]]s at two camps for [[Internally displaced person|displaced people]] in Lac Vert and Mugunga, in [[North Kivu]], Democratic Republic of the Congo. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-bomb-violence-refugees-killings-kivu-c548d887e17ec86e24ba3e1caabd5555 (AP)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**Two people are killed and two others are injured by [[Russia|Russian]] shelling in the city of [[Kurakhove]] in the [[Donetsk oblast]]. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2024/05/03/russian-shelling-kills-2-in-eastern-donetsk-region-a85024 (''The Moscow Times'')]
**[[United Kingdom|British]] [[Foreign Secretary (United Kingdom)|Foreign Secretary]] [[David Cameron]] promises £3 billion of annual [[military aid]] to [[Ukraine]] for "as long as it takes." [https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/britains-cameron-kyiv-promises-ukraine-aid-as-long-it-takes-2024-05-02/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israel–Hamas war]]
**The [[United States]] tells [[Qatar]] to evict [[Hamas]] if the latter obstructs an Israeli hostage deal. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2024/05/03/us-qatar-hamas-hostages-ceasefire/ (''The Washington Post'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*The U.S. [[Federal Trade Commission]] gives [[ExxonMobil]] approval in the [[Mergers and acquisitions|acquisition]] of [[Pioneer Natural Resources]] for $60 billion. [https://www.cnbc.com/2024/05/01/exxon-mobil-reaches-agreement-with-ftc-poised-to-close-60-billion-pioneer-deal.html (CNBC)]
*[[Panama]] bans [[First Quantum Minerals]] from extracting copper following the closure of its [[Cobre mine, Panama|Cobre Panamá]] mine last year. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities/panama-bar-first-quantum-mining-copper-during-closure-process-2024-05-03/ (Reuters)] [https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/article-panama-to-bar-first-quantum-from-mining-copper-during-shutdown/ (''The Globe and Mail'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Rio Grande do Sul floods]]
**The death toll from the heavy rains in southern [[Brazil]] increases to 39 people, with more than 70 others missing. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/rains-southern-brazil-kill-least-31-more-than-70-still-missing-2024-05-03/ (Reuters)] 
*A bus plunges into a [[ravine]] in [[Diamer District]], [[Pakistan]], killing 20 people and seriously injuring 30 others. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-bus-crash-karakoram-highway-532fe3a061525fcefd0fb5aec99b5cb4 (AP)]
*Thirteen people are killed and 2,000 homes are [[flood]]ed during heavy rains in [[Haiti]], mainly in the city of [[Cap-Haitien]]. Rains occurs also in [[Puerto Rico]], where planes are landed in [[San Juan, Puerto Rico|San Juan]] to reroute. [https://apnews.com/article/haiti-rains-flooding-landslide-killed-d82b1738208820e057bdcc58a84bf99e (AP)]
*[[Federal Police (Mexico)|Mexican authorities]] locate the bodies of three tourists, one [[United States|American]] and two [[Australia|Australians]], in [[Baja California]], where they were reported missing in April. Three people have been arrested and are being questioned in relation to the case. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/three-bodies-found-area-where-australian-us-tourists-went-missing-sources-2024-05-03/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cd13e9pjjgjo (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Canada–India diplomatic row]]
**Three [[India|Indian]] men are arrested in [[Canada]] and charged with the murder of [[Sikhs|Sikh]] [[Khalistan movement|separatist]] leader [[Hardeep Singh Nijjar]] last year. The [[Government of Canada|Canadian government]] is investigating whether the men had ties to the [[Government of India|Indian government]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/canadian-police-have-made-arrests-case-killing-sikh-leader-nijjar-says-cbc-2024-05-03/ (Reuters)] [https://www.thestar.com/news/canada/british-columbia/police-say-3-men-arrested-charged-in-the-killing-of-b-c-sikh-activist-hardeep/article_02d57f42-5c6d-5239-80ec-e84aaf9edc04.html (''Toronto Star'')]
*[[Capital punishment in the Democratic Republic of the Congo]]
**A [[military court]] in the [[Democratic Republic of the Congo]] sentences eight soldiers to death for cowardice and other crimes. [https://apnews.com/article/congo-trial-military-desertion-violence-5302f6d4d26fe5484e6a1c1e5578b424 (AP)]
*[[United States House of Representatives|U.S. Representative]] [[Henry Cuellar]] is indicted for accepting nearly $600,000 worth of bribes from an [[Azerbaijan]]-controlled company and a [[Mexico|Mexican]] bank. [https://apnews.com/article/henry-cuellar-texas-azerbaijan-ddb1dea393ba88d8d823557ec6c0d93a (AP)]
*The [[International Criminal Court]] warns against outside interference, saying that efforts to undermine the court's work must "cease immediately". [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2024/05/03/israel-hamas-war-news-gaza-palestine/ (''The Washington Post'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Israel–Hamas war protests]]
**[[2024 pro-Palestinian protests on university campuses]]
***[[2024 Sciences Po pro-Palestinian occupation protest]]
****[[National Police (France)|French police]] evacuate [[Sciences Po|Sciences Po University]] in [[Paris]] and close the university in response to pro-Palestine protests and building occupations by students. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/frances-sciences-po-university-closed-over-new-gaza-protests-2024-05-03/ (Reuters)] [https://www.lemonde.fr/en/international/article/2024/05/03/sciences-po-announces-closure-of-main-paris-site-over-gaza-protest_6670250_4.html (''Le Monde'')]
***The [[Houthi movement|Houthis]] offer American students who have been suspended in [[2024 pro-Palestinian protests on university campuses|pro-Palestine protests]] education at [[Sanaa University]] in [[Yemen]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/houthis-offer-education-students-suspended-us-protest-crackdown-2024-05-03/ (Reuters)]
***Students at the [[National Autonomous University of Mexico]] hold pro-Palestine solidarity encampments and protests. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20240503-pro-palestinian-students-camp-out-at-mexico-s-largest-university (''France24'')]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Chinese space program]]
**The [[China National Space Administration]] launches the [[Chang'e 6]] spacecraft from the [[Wenchang Space Launch Site]] on a two-month mission to collect lunar rock and soil samples from the [[far side of the Moon]]. [https://www.reuters.com/science/china-launches-historic-mission-retrieve-samples-far-side-moon-2024-05-03/ (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/article/china-lunar-probe-sample-return-space-def5b9e054fbc3a681952d3c7ad002fe (AP)]
